from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/41410/1_41410_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/41410_0_e2bcd7d0/1_41410_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active

# Extract all Lighting rows from the source range B3:D22
lighting_rows = []
for row in range(3, 23):
    item = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value
    if item == "Lighting":
        lighting_rows.append([
            ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value
        ])

# Only modify the required answer cells F4:H6.
# F3:H3 already contains the first extracted Lighting row in the provided table,
# so populate the remaining rows starting at F4.
for r in range(4, 7):
    for c in range(6, 9):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = None

for idx, data_row in enumerate(lighting_rows[1:4], start=4):
    for col_offset, value in enumerate(data_row, start=6):
        ws.cell(row=idx, column=col_offset).value = value

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
